reason: Fast Landing successor authorization for immutable diagnostic-lineage poisoning in PR #645. The original tests-only authority #644 correctly established the WhatsApp structured-egress P0 scope, but the first diagnostic head 55e11bcae89fa68519050fe8068239205b86b956 was polluted by SQLite broker setup failures. A second tests-only diagnostic head 8207da9cd09f1e3b2236dbd9bff92c7931e583f1 removed that harness pollution and cleanly reproduced all nine intended WhatsApp structured-egress failures, but its commit message used custom Prior-RED-* trailers rather than the exact Yance-Failure-First-Red-* trailers required by the already-merged Fast Closure V2 evaluator. Because the evaluator validates every first-parent diagnostic commit, the published lineage cannot be repaired by a descendant commit without history rewrite. PR #645 is therefore frozen closed/unmerged. V2 supersedes the old authority, keeps production scope at zero, preserves the identical one-path diagnostic scope and restarts on a fresh implementation branch from the effective V2 authorization merge so a clean immutable causal RED can be produced without amend/rebase/force-push/history rewrite.

supersedes.reason: PR #645 first-parent history contains second diagnostic commit 8207da9cd09f1e3b2236dbd9bff92c7931e583f1 without the exact standard failure-first evidence trailers required by Fast Closure V2; a descendant commit cannot erase that immutable per-commit policy failure.
